skill.name: pitfalls-tanstack-query
skill.description: Guides TanStack Query v5 implementation by checking query keys, mutation invalidation, loading state names, typed responses, and optimistic update rollbacks.
skill.summary: Review TanStack Query v5 code for common cache and mutation mistakes.
skill.author: BarisSozen

content.value_statement: TanStack Query mistakes can cause duplicate requests, stale cache data, and broken mutation states. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused checks for v5 query and mutation patterns.
actual_capabilities: Checks query keys for full URL path patterns used in examples.
Reviews mutation success handlers for relevant query invalidation.
Highlights TanStack Query v5 state naming, including isPending for mutations.
Guides typed useQuery responses with shared schema types.
Explains optimistic update flow with cancel, snapshot, rollback, and settle steps.
limitations: Does not execute tests, inspect runtime cache behavior, or verify API responses.
Focuses on TanStack Query v5 and may not fit older React Query versions.
Provides review guidance only; it does not modify source files automatically.
Examples use simplified API calls and may need project-specific adaptation.

use_cases.title: Audit a new query flow
use_cases.description: Check query keys, typed responses, and loading states before connecting a React view to server data.

use_cases.title: Review mutation behavior
use_cases.description: Verify that mutations invalidate related queries and keep cached screens current after writes.

use_cases.title: Plan a v5 migration
use_cases.description: Identify v4 habits, such as mutation isLoading, that need replacement in TanStack Query v5.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Query Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this React component for TanStack Query v5 query key issues. Focus on useQuery keys and stale data risks.

prompt_templates.title: Mutation Invalidation Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect these useMutation handlers for missing invalidation. Explain which queries should be invalidated and why.

prompt_templates.title: v5 Migration Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this React Query code against TanStack Query v5 patterns. Flag state names, mutation usage, and cache assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Optimistic Update Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a TanStack Query v5 optimistic update flow for this edit feature. Include snapshot, rollback, invalidation, and failure handling.

output_examples.input: A product edit mutation returns success, but the list page still shows old data.
output_examples.output: The review flags missing invalidation after mutation success. It recommends refreshing the product list and affected detail records.

output_examples.input: A team migrates mutations from React Query v4 to TanStack Query v5.
output_examples.output: The output identifies legacy loading state names and recommends the v5 pending state terminology for mutation UI.

output_examples.input: An edit screen needs instant feedback while the network request is pending.
output_examples.output: The guidance outlines snapshot, optimistic cache update, rollback on failure, and final invalidation after settlement.

best_practices: Use complete, stable query keys that match the data scope shown in the route.
Invalidate related queries after successful mutations that change server state.
Pair optimistic updates with snapshot and rollback logic before invalidating.
anti_patterns: Using short query keys that merge unrelated cache entries.
Navigating away after mutation success without refreshing affected queries.
Using v4 mutation loading state names in TanStack Query v5 code.

faq.question: Does this skill execute project code?
faq.answer: No. It provides review guidance based on the TanStack Query examples in the skill.

faq.question: Which TanStack Query version does it target?
faq.answer: It targets TanStack Query v5 patterns, including mutation pending state naming.

faq.question: Can it help with stale cache bugs?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on query keys, invalidation, and optimistic update rollback paths.

faq.question: Does it replace tests?
faq.answer: No. Use it with component tests, integration tests, and manual verification.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Will it write code changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. It gives review prompts and expected checks for a developer or agent to apply.
